## Bugs and feature requests

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/RedberryProducts/synapse/issues) before opening a new report. Use the bug-report or feature-request form and include the smallest example that demonstrates the problem.

For bugs, include Synapse, PHP, Laravel, Laravel AI SDK, and optional Laravel MCP versions; your server/runtime; reproduction steps; expected and actual behavior; and relevant redacted errors. Keep API keys, credentials, private prompts, customer data, and sensitive security details out of public issues.
